rationale: The Latin anchor *separare* and the Gospel quotation "veni separare hominem adversus patrem suum" (I came to set a man against his father) indicate an active, causative sense of separating/disjoining, which matches disjoin.v.01 ("make disjoint… undo the joining of") rather than the intransitive/inchoative disjoin.v.02. The OE a-syndran is used transitively here as an agent-driven act of separation.
